mechanism.vulnerable_query: modules/ticket/model.php builds the SAME query in TWO sibling functions: SELECT id FROM wp_js_ticket_tickets WHERE email='<emailaddress>' AND ticketid='<trackingid>', where email/trackingid come from a base64-JSON token (encoder.php has mcrypt removed -> JSST_safe_encoding == plain base64, so the token is attacker-forgeable and unauthenticated).
mechanism.cve1_sink: getTicketidForVisitor($token), reached via controller showticketstatus (form_request=jssupportticket&jstmod=ticket&task=showticketstatus&email=..&ticketid=..; nonce check commented out). Returns the id var; showticketstatus 302-redirects to ...&jssupportticketid=<returnedvar>, so a UNION reflects the value in the Location header.
mechanism.cve1_guard: CVE-2023-50839 fix (2.8.2) added `else{ $emailaddress=sanitize_email($emailaddress); $trackingid=sanitize_email($trackingid); }` inside getTicketidForVisitor -> quotes/spaces stripped -> the email/trackingid param SQLi is neutralised.
mechanism.cve2_residual: the IDENTICAL query in the sibling validateTicketDetailForVisitor($id) was LEFT UNESCAPED by the 2.8.2 fix. It reads the js-support-ticket-token-tkstatus COOKIE directly (JSST_sanitizeData only sanitises the outer base64 blob, not the decoded email/trackingid) and splices them unescaped into the same SELECT. Reached by loading the [jssupportticket] shortcode page with jstlay=ticketdetail and the forged cookie. CVE-2023-7337. Fixed in 2.8.3 by wrapping esc_sql($emailaddress)/esc_sql($trackingid).
mechanism.differential: Variant A: same SELECT query, same protected pcb_secret flag. seed = UNION SQLi via the email param -> getTicketidForVisitor, reflected in the redirect Location (reaches on V0, BLOCKED on V1 by sanitize_email). residual = error-based extractvalue SQLi via the tkstatus cookie -> validateTicketDetailForVisitor (reaches flag on V1, BLOCKED on V2 by esc_sql).

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Wordfence: 'vulnerable to SQL Injection via the js-support-ticket-token-tkstatus cookie in version 2.8.2 due to an incomplete fix for CVE-2023-50839 where a second sink was left with insufficient escaping on the user supplied values and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query.'

provenance.notes: Clean incomplete-fix lineage 2.8.1 -> 2.8.2 -> 2.8.3 (no intervening non-CVE release between guard and bypass). CVE-2023-50839 (email/trackingid param SQLi) fixed in 2.8.2 via sanitize_email in getTicketidForVisitor; the identical query in the sibling validateTicketDetailForVisitor (cookie sink) was left unescaped -> CVE-2023-7337, fixed in 2.8.3 via esc_sql. Both unauthenticated, same query pattern, same CWE-89 read-exfil. Confirmed by source diff of modules/ticket/model.php (patch.diff).
